data.body: Live admission closeout evidence: preview after the merged change found candidate material for G3 (agent tier, sample_n=5), G4 (agent tier, sample_n=5), and no current decomp-shape samples (sample_n=0). A bounded live smoke did not mint specs because the existing fixture-heal production path failed before model scoring: first the manifest directory was absent, then after creating it, eval_solver refused agentic filesystem tools outside gate_source.gate_read_root. That is an existing live-heal runner availability defect, not this material-persistence change; filed follow-up nocturnal-valorous-zebra and linked discovered_from. The original scope here is complete: corpus/admission now faithfully handles per-child material and withholds legacy/unrecoverable child rows.
